ctx.x: Have the flowers when you could smell them. Well, we had a situation happen ... I didn't know too much about it and Babe and I had gotten a little tape recorder and put out our records. She loved Louis. She loved Louis musically and so we wanted to tape our tunes so we recorded together just
some things for Q.R.S., you remember? And, she did some things individually with Connie Barry and Cozy and the organist. BT: Dan Baker, organist
